story.fullStory:
Aurora's "Cure For Me" — original release 2022. "Cure for Me" is a song by Norwegian singer-songwriter Aurora for her fourth studio album, The Gods We Can Touch (2022).

Artist: Aurora · Title: Cure For Me · Album: Aurora (16) - Cure For Me · Year: 2021 · Genre: Indie Pop · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/2020's/Aurora - Cure For Me.mp4.

It was released on 7 July 2021, through Decca and Glassnote, as the second single from the album.

An electropop, disco, Europop, and dance-pop song with elements of EDM music, it interpolates "Aquarela do Brasil", written by Brazilian composer Ary Barroso.
